verdict.why: vitest list now parses files statically by default instead of running them, which can change the output.

draft.detail: Since Vitest 5, vitest list parses test files statically instead of running them to collect tests; pass --no-static-parse to run the files instead.

test.error: FAIL: vitest list ran the test file's top-level code to collect tests

source.quote: Since Vitest 5, `vitest list` [parses test files](/api/advanced/vitest#parsespecifications) statically instead of running them to collect tests. Pass `--no-static-parse` to run the files instead.
